findings.message: The LAME tag of 1 frame is followed by bytes that are not audio before the first audio frame, so the music CRC is not verified; the first at 0x0.
100 bytes after the Info header frame, before the next frame at 0x205, are not audio.

1 frame has main data that reaches back into the Xing, Info or VBRI header frame before it, the first at 0x205. minimp3 decodes it from its bytes, mpg123 and ffmpeg skip that frame and decode it with data missing; the stream was probably cut and the header frame written afterwards.
